name: Someone to Hold
tagline: We wait on hold. You take over when a human answers.
summary: We sit through the hold music and ring you when a person picks up.
concept: Hold music takes time and no skill. We supply the time.
who_its_for: Anyone with a call to make to an energy company, a council or an airline.
how_it_works: Book a call: £6, including up to 60 minutes on hold.
Give us the number and what the call is about.
We call and wait. We never give your details or pretend to be you.
When a human answers, we put you through and you take over.

page.headline: Someone to wait on hold
page.intro: We wait on hold. You take over when a human answers.

sections.title: Prices
sections.body: £6 per call, up to 60 minutes on hold. £3 for each extra 30 minutes.

sections.title: What we do
sections.body: You give us the number and what it's about. We wait, then hand over when a person answers.

sections.title: What we will not do
sections.body: We do not give your details or pretend to be you. We do not hold for emergency, medical or bank security lines.

faq.a: £6 per call, covering up to 60 minutes on hold. Each extra 30 minutes is £3.

faq.q: What do you need from me?
faq.a: The number, and what the call is about.

faq.q: Do you talk to them for me?
faq.a: No. We wait. When a person answers, you take over.
Never. We do not give your details or pretend to be you.

faq.q: Which calls won't you hold for?
faq.a: Emergency, medical, or bank security lines.
You pay for the time we waited, up to the limit.
Full refund up to 24 hours before. None after that.
